question: does swapping the plant to 0807 change the measured-racket retarget?
answer: no: on all 73 clips every gate is identical between plants, and residuals move by about 1% of gate budget

experiment_design.controlled: same source bytes, same venv, same solver, same inputs; only the MJCF/URDF pair varies
experiment_design.why: the v4 bank was produced in an unknown environment, so re-solving the 0409 baseline here is the only way to attribute a difference to the plant rather than to the toolchain
experiment_design.cpu_only: the solver uses CPU MuJoCo and scipy.minimize; no GPU was taken

inputs_located.body_retarget_pkl: /workspace/yikang/chingmu_gmr/chingmu_a3_units_v2/ -- matches the manifest's source_pkl_sha256; the path in docs/operations/setup_local_sync.md (chingmu_retarget/chingmu_a3_units_v2) has moved
inputs_located.joint_order_contract: configs/a3_joint_order_bijection_v1.json plus the two order .txt files it resolves repo-relative

single_clip_control.gates_false_note: these are the known v4 mechanical-admission failures; identical on both plants, so not swap-induced
single_clip_control.verdict: the swap is benign for the retarget; every residual stays orders of magnitude inside its gate

full_bank_rebuild.solver: the recovered v4d, pristine on 0409; on 0807 an otherwise identical copy whose single MJCF SHA constant became a two-entry allowlist
full_bank_rebuild.reproduces_v4: 73/73 on 0409 matches the v4 bank's own admission, which is what confirms this is the right tool

gate_comparison.verdict: every gate lands identically on both plants for every clip

residual_movement.note: residuals move slightly, mostly worse in count but negligible in size against the gate budgets
residual_movement.worst_case_as_fraction_of_gate: about 1% of the face/so3 budget and 1.6% of the position budget

full_bank_rebuild.not_yet_done: materialize_measured_racket_motion_npz + audit_materialized_measured_racket_npz have not been run, so no npz bank has been written and no bank receipt minted

solver_change_made_here.change: the two single-value MJCF/URDF SHA pins became KNOWN_PLANTS, a keyed allowlist; the report now records which plant key was used
solver_change_made_here.why_not_a_loosening: a plant is admissible only if its MJCF and URDF appear under the SAME key, so an unknown model or a mismatched pair from two plants is still refused
solver_change_made_here.pre_existing_test_failure: test_chingmu_canonical_racket_solver.py is 1 failed / 14 passed both before and after this change; the failure is numpy._core unpickling on the py3.8 host

next_step_options: recover or re-derive the v4-era solver behaviour, then rebuild the bank on 0807
accept the tracked solver as the new authority, rebuild the bank on 0807 at whatever admission it gives, and re-sign the bank gates against that denominator
CORRECTION_20260808: the first version of this receipt concluded the bank rebuild was BLOCKED because the v4-era solver 'exists in neither the git history nor any copy on the pod'. The solver was recovered from both, byte-verified, and the full 73-clip rebuild then succeeded.
